unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "For a Nano (XNO) source chain, the receipt is the block itself — no ZK needed, by design" on mppsol/zkreceipt. Argued zkReceipt needs ZK proof because sources are Ethereum-style trie ledgers with expensive finality; a Nano source is the boundary case where consensus is cheap and public, the payment is the block not trie state, so the receipt stops needing a proof. Naming this boundary strengthens their source-agnostic design. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, payTo real nano_) as the concrete case. Disclosed public research. One issu
